detail: Full summary: Migration safety of new optional Decision fields is structural: export tree (stableStringify of full object), sqlite data blob, ingest, and reverse re-serialization all carry the whole Decision — any future optional field round-trips for free. Covered by a regression test in test/migrate/reverse.test.ts.
